Not stated for most authors; corresponding author e-mail at microsoft.com, with a note that the work was conducted independently in the author's personal capacity and does not reflect Microsoft's views

Proposes an evaluation method (time-consistent PR-based benchmark protocol with matched A/B design for repository-knowledge augmentation); secondary: evaluates (baseline-only characterization of prompt granularity x model)

No SDD approach. Object of the protocol: repository-derived code knowledge layer (not evaluated here). Varied factor in the study: task prompt granularity (Minimal, Concise, Contextual, Guided) generated by an LLM from historical PRs

Natural-language task prompts derived from PRs at four granularity levels (Minimal: from PR title; Concise: affected component; Contextual: functionality/usage/failure mode; Guided: structured guidance on the fix without exposing the implementation); repository-derived code knowledge built from snapshot t0 (source, commit history, docs) for the augmented arm

Benchmark protocol: snapshot repository at t0 -> build repository knowledge from pre-t0 artefacts only -> collect PRs merged in (t0, t1] -> LLM converts each PR to a task prompt at granularity l -> run same SWE agent with and without repository knowledge -> compare predicted files with PR-modified files

Criterion: file-level F1 vs PR-modified files; baseline arm only (no repository knowledge); agent not stated. DragonFly F1 (recall / precision in Table 2), Minimal / Concise / Contextual / Guided: Claude Sonnet 4: 0.2026 / 0.3916 / 0.5592 / 0.6828; Claude Sonnet 4.5: 0.2487 / 0.4124 / 0.5656 / 0.7163; 'Claude-Ops-4.6' (Opus 4.6): 0.2952 / 0.5464 / 0.7241 / 0.8081. React F1: Sonnet 4: 0.1898 / 0.3710 / 0.4594 / 0.6283; Sonnet 4.5: 0.1946 / 0.3751 / 0.5062 / 0.7229; Opus 4.6: 0.2335 / 0.5098 / 0.6057 / 0.8078. React averaged over models: mean F1 0.242 / 0.479 / 0.574 / 0.770; Precision=0 rate 60.2% / 28.7% / 18.5% / 3.5%; Recall=1 rate 14.4% / 31.1% / 41.5% / 59.8%. Verdicts: Minimal does not work; Concise partly; Contextual partly; Guided works (quality, localization only); cost N/A (not measured)

Baseline characterization: 2 repositories x 3 Claude models x 4 prompt granularities; no knowledge-augmented arm. Held constant (by design): snapshot, task set, environment, metric; agent not named. Acceptance tests: none (file-overlap with ground-truth PR). Repetitions: not stated (apparently 1). Human intervention: not stated

F1 rises monotonically from Minimal to Guided for every model and repository (e.g. DragonFly Opus 4.6 0.2952 -> 0.8081; React Opus 4.6 0.2335 -> 0.8078); stronger models better at each granularity; largest jump often Concise -> Contextual. No significance tests

Distinguished prompt granularities and models; the A/B knowledge comparison (main purpose) not yet run. Repeatability: claimed cross-repository consistency; no repetitions or CIs. Limitations stated: no paired augmented-vs-baseline deltas, incomplete uncertainty reporting, prompt templates and leakage filters not given, file-level metric only, two repositories, two DragonFly Concise detail exports missing

Prompt granularity is a first-order benchmark variable; Contextual recommended as default. Gaps: complete matched A/B evaluation with task-level deltas, uncertainty estimates, exact prompt templates, execution-based correctness (patch/test pass), broader repository coverage

Prompt level 'Concise' appears as 'Abstract' in Figures 2-5, 9-10. Model 'Claude-Ops-4.6' presumably Claude Opus 4.6 (as written).
